themes.appearancePairs: neutral tokens with a -dark sibling follow the system appearance

display-widget.purpose: End of Shift widget countdown (32px small, 44px medium), monospaced digits.

headline.purpose: Settings page title under the page symbol.

title-hero.purpose: Popover next-break countdown on the glass hero.

title-popover.purpose: The date line at the top of the popover.

title-section.purpose: Section heading over a hairline; selected sidebar row; callout title.

body.purpose: Row titles, page descriptions, sidebar and menu rows.

body-small.purpose: Row detail, section footers, slider and stepper read-outs.

value.purpose: Lane counts and countdown-row values, monospaced digits.

button.purpose: Accent and soft capsule labels (14px when large).

label.purpose: Sidebar status, popover captions, hour and day labels.

shadows.name: ring-glow
shadows.purpose: The single soft glow, on the full-screen break's tapered countdown ring. The floating break card's 64px ring and the popover's 48px ring have none.

shadows.name: icon-template
shadows.purpose: Under the app icon squircle, per Apple's template.

glass.name: popover-hero
glass.value: Liquid Glass regular, tint eyes-accent 10%, radius 16
glass.purpose: The one floating card in the popover.

glass.name: toast
glass.value: Liquid Glass over behind-window blur (frosted), tint eyes 8% / water 14%, radius 22
glass.purpose: Warning toast, water toast, unlock prompt, floating break card (440px, radius 24), blink pill (capsule).

glass.name: break-overlay
glass.value: Liquid Glass guide card radius 28 (full-screen water card 36) over full-screen frost plus the palette backdrop

glass.name: reduce-transparency
glass.value: opaque window background + tint, 1px rim at 15% primary
glass.purpose: Every glass surface under Reduce Transparency.

motion.name: step-crossfade
motion.value: ease-out 0.2s opacity; none under Reduce Motion

motion.name: disclosure-chevron
motion.value: ease-out 0.2s, chevron turns 90deg; none under Reduce Motion
motion.purpose: More options / Work out my goal opening (state).

motion.name: toast-fade
motion.purpose: Toasts, pills and the floating break card appearing and leaving.

rhythm.recover: 9% of the window, min 600s, cosine ease
rhythm.window: today's shift, else 8 AM-8 PM, widened to include recorded events
rhythm.weekDot: 2.2x line width; empty day = open ring 3x line width on paper

layout.essentialsPerPage: at most 4; the rest under More options (26px above)

derivedInks.inkSoft: most muted mix of ink toward the surface clearing 6.0:1 (7.6:1 light-on-dark)
derivedInks.why: light text on dark rasterises at about 0.72 of nominal contrast on macOS

themes.name: Greenhouse
themes.character: Leaf green, terracotta signal; pairs with Garden.

localization.direction: Right to left in Arabic; rhythm and week lines use flipsForRightToLeftLayoutDirection; day labels mirror; widgets follow the app's language
localization.digits: Locale digits (localizedDigits); break countdown digits kept left to right
localization.voice: Calm and factual; no exclamation marks; no health claims beyond docs/EVIDENCE.md

narrative.overview:
EyeBreak is a calm Mac productivity app in the TickTick/Notion lineage. Content sits on opaque paper: a page is an SF Symbol, a large bold title and one line of description, then sections set by a semibold heading over a hairline, then flat rows with a title and one line of detail on the left and a native control on the right. Type and spacing do the grouping. There are no boxed grouped forms, stat tiles or card grids. The window has four pages, one per need (Breaks, Water, Workday, App); each shows at most four essentials and folds the rest under "More options".

Liquid Glass is the accent, not the ground. It appears only where something floats over the user's work or desktop: the window's sidebar, the popover's hero card holding the next-break countdown, toasts, and break overlays. Everything else is solid. Colour belongs to the habits. The theme's eye colour (violet, or leaf green in Garden) marks breaks and the app's own chrome. Its water colour (aqua, or rain blue) marks water. One red (`Theme.alert`) is held in reserve for a warning; nothing draws in it today. Neutrals are warm ink on paper with hairlines.

The signature is the rhythm line. Each habit draws one line across today's shift. It stays straight while the user keeps up and catches, dipping and easing back, at each skipped break or missed glass. The same view draws it in the popover, at the top of the Breaks and Water pages and in the Rhythm widget, and the app icon is that line drawn large.

EyeBreak speaks English and Arabic (Modern Standard Arabic). In Arabic the whole interface mirrors right to left, the rhythm lines and day labels included, and times are set in the locale's digits. The voice is calm and factual in both languages.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque paper pages, warm ink, 1px hairlines; flat rows, never boxed groups.
Glass only where something floats: the sidebar, the popover hero, toasts, break overlays.
Two habit colours per theme, plus one red held in reserve; accents mark action, selection and state, never decoration.
Solid colours only. No gradients anywhere.
SF Pro (never Rounded), SF Symbols, monospaced digits for every live number.
The rhythm line as the one chart idiom: straight while on track, catching at each miss.
English and Arabic, mirrored right to left down to the lines; no hard-coded strings.

rules.name: The Colour Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Eye colour means eyes, breaks and app chrome. Water colour means water. Alert red is reserved for a warning and unused today. A widget theme's heroAccent means the shift. Resting icons are secondary ink. If a colour can't name its job, it doesn't ship.

rules.name: The Solid Only Rule
rules.body: Every fill is one flat colour: icons, buttons, selections, charts, backdrops. Gradients are prohibited, with no exceptions.

rules.name: The Garden Icon Rule
rules.body: The app icon is drawn in Garden's linen (garden-paper), herb green (garden-eyes-deep) and watering-can blue (garden-water-deep) whichever theme is active. It is the one place the per-theme colour rule doesn't apply.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Page sections, rows, descriptions and widget headers are in sentence case. Title Case is only for buttons and menu items ("Take a Break Now", "Every 4th Break").

rules.name: The Ticking Digits Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes while you watch is set in monospaced digits so it doesn't jitter, in the locale's own digits (`localizedDigits`; Arabic-Indic where the locale uses them). The break countdowns keep their digits in left-to-right order in every language.

rules.name: The No Box Rule
rules.body: Group with a heading over a hairline and with spacing. Never wrap settings in boxed forms, group boxes, stat tiles or card grids. The wash callout is the one tinted block, for the one thing on a page worth reading first.

rules.name: The Glass Floats Rule
rules.body: Glass only where something floats: the sidebar, the popover hero, toasts, break overlays. A page, a row or a widget is never glass.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: The tapered countdown ring on the full-screen break gets one soft solid glow. Nothing else glows.

dos: **Do** take every colour from `ThemeColors` by its job. Reach for the token (paper, ink, secondary-ink, hairline, wash, the eye and water ramps), not a literal.

**Do** build Settings pages from the page grammar: symbol, 26px bold title, one-line description, then sections of a 13px semibold heading over a 1px hairline, then flat 40px-minimum rows. Keep a page to four essentials and put the rest under More options.
**Do** put text on solid fills only in its paired colour: white on eyes-deep, water-ink on water-bright.
**Do** use monospaced digits for every countdown and live value.
**Do** say it with a rhythm line when showing how the day or week is going.
**Do** take every user-facing string from the string catalog (`Localizable.xcstrings`, `String(localized:)`; shared code via `String(shared:)`). Never hard-code one.
**Do** mirror anything time-based in right to left (lines, week lines, day labels) and set times in the locale's digits; keep break countdown digits left to right.
**Do** write copy calm and factual in both languages: no exclamation marks, no health claim beyond `docs/EVIDENCE.md`.
**Do** derive secondary text on widget surfaces from the surface (`Contrast.muted`), with floors of 6.0 / 4.7 (7.6 / 6.5 light-on-dark).
donts: **Don't** use gradients anywhere: icons, buttons, selections, charts, backdrops.
**Don't** put glass on pages, rows or widgets. Glass is for the sidebar, the popover hero, toasts and break overlays.
**Don't** box settings into grouped forms, stat tiles or card grids.
**Don't** use red. `Theme.alert` is reserved for a warning, and nothing draws in it today; a skipped-breaks note is neutral.
**Don't** put anything on a break beyond the countdown, the guide card and its actions: no quotes, no pictures of damage.
**Don't** use SF Rounded, a second typeface, or emoji in the app's own UI. Custom ambient reminders may carry the user's own emoji.

**Don't** add decorative motion. Motion only conveys state: the ring ticking down, the break step cross-fading, a disclosure chevron turning (0.2s ease-out), and toasts fading in and out. All of it stops under Reduce Motion: the ring steps once a second and toasts simply appear.
**Don't** add a glow or shadow beyond the countdown ring's glow and the icon's template shadow.
